_doc: Known comma big driving models. first_public: the first date the weights were public (openpilot master or Hugging Face). on_master: the date they were merged to openpilot master, null if never. The site's timeline is ordered by first_public (ties broken by id); a model's second baseline is the model just before it, or in a section where that model has no scores, the latest earlier model that has them. source is the file scored, and its date can be later than first_public (a release tag or a re-upload of the same weights). Lineage facts are borrowed from comma's GitHub PRs and Hugging Face upload history; 'same weights' claims were checked by tensor bytes (deep dive 2026-10-27). Models before lebowski (0.9.5 to 0.11.1, engine 'legacy') are comma's default comma 3/3X models of each release, scored with engines/legacy.py under their own release's inputs and command; a split model's sha256 is vision+policy.

models.name: Farmville
models.notes: Shipped in openpilot 0.9.5. One supercombo with a lateral planner head: the steering command is the 0.9.5 lateral planner on the model's planner solution (lat_planner_solution), lag-adjusted as controlsd did. No acceleration command (the longitudinal MPC planned it), so no longitudinal scores. Checkpoint bf8b2580/449 (vision) d09c9c88/700 (policy). Navigation inputs zero.
limits: A historical model, run outside comma's software with its own release's inputs, camera warp and command (engines/legacy.py). Checked against comma's CI model replay of this model (made on a comma device, 600 frames of one route): the plan's lateral position is 0.030 m RMS from comma's output; every other model here is 0.38 m or more from it on the same check.

Trained for the comma devices and cameras of its time, not for the G55's camera or for every camera among comma's public segments: of those 45 segments 26 record the OX03C10 sensor, 6 the AR0231, 4 the OS04C10 and 9 none; 30 were recorded 2021 to 2024 and 15 come from devices whose route names carry no date.
Not run in closed loop: the G55 closed-loop and recovery tests need this release's controller inside the world-model loop, which is not built yet.
No acceleration command: before openpilot 0.10 the longitudinal MPC, not the model, chose the acceleration, so the longitudinal action metrics are empty; the plan's speeds are scored.

The steering command is this release's (the lateral planner on the model's planner solution, lag-adjusted, unsmoothed); from 0.10 modeld smooths its command and the newest models are scored on their own action head, so lateral action rates are not comparable across these eras.

models.name: lebowski
models.notes: 877M ConvNeXt encoder, host-kept history, no RL residual. Checkpoint 6f5c8d09/ecc73f48. The model the G55 runs.

models.name: Cinque v2
models.notes: On openpilot master 2026-09-11 (PR #38850). Vision base b9facbcc, history in the graph, no residual head.

models.name: Cinque v3
models.notes: On openpilot master 2026-09-18 (PR #38932). Vision base b9facbcc, no residual head.
Uploaded as "mountain dew model"; never shipped. Vision base f22e06e5 with an RL residual head.

models.name: Mountain Dew
models.notes: Shipped in openpilot 0.11.2 (master 2026-10-10, PR #39047). Scored from the Hugging Face upload of 2026-10-14, whose tensors match the release's compiled model byte for byte. Vision base f22e06e5 with an RL residual head.

models.name: MD v3 / Flip Flop
models.notes: On openpilot master as MD v3 (2026-10-14, PR #39087) and again as Flip Flop (2026-10-24, PR #39156), same weights. Scored from the 2026-10-24 Hugging Face re-upload, weights identical to the 2026-10-16 upload. Vision base f22e06e5 with an RL residual head.

models.name: N16 nav model
models.notes: Uploaded as "add N16 nav model"; never shipped. Takes a navigation map and route inputs, fed zeros here (no route). Vision base 2931d3d9 with an RL residual head.
